claude pane, every row wrong. Two turns tiled the whole 100-row screen (0..9, 10..99), so Write(labs/turn-identity/Cargo.toml), ⎿ Wrote 11 lines to…, numbered file contents, and Ran 1 shell command
all reported turn 172 or 177. Codex's four phantoms were the input box (ask codex to do anything), the usage notice, the status line, and the tmux status bar.
Cause
0_terminalTurnVisibility.ts:138-152. After matching, every turn's span is rewritten to tile the viewport: first turn's start becomes viewportStart, every turn's end becomes nextTurn.bufferStart - 1,
last turn's end becomes viewportEnd. turnAtBufferRow then did plain range containment over those spans, so every row on screen belonged to some turn by construction. Both located turns carried
confidence: "extended" — neither had an anchor anywhere near the rows it claimed.
Fix
│                  file                   │                        change                         │
│ src/0_terminalTurnVisibility.ts:18-19   │ VisibleTurn gains anchorStart / anchorEnd             │
│ src/0_terminalTurnVisibility.ts:127-135 │ recorded from the matched hit rows, before extension  │
│ src/0_terminalTurnVisibility.ts:238-241 │ turnAtBufferRow answers from the anchor, not the span │
│ src/1a_terminalContextQueue.ts:32-38    │ turnsAcrossRange tags a selection by anchor overlap   │
The extended span stays and still drives region projection and the gutter. Identity now says "no Boop turn at pointer" instead of guessing — that menu item already existed at chrome.ts:383 and had
no way to fire.
After
│  pane  │ scored rows │ correct │ wrong │ missing │ phantom │
Read the claude row honestly: it gained no true positives. Claude Code renders tool-call chrome that is not in agent_turn.said, so only rows 2 and 10 are attributable at all out of 100. The win is
that the other 98 now report nothing instead of lying. Codex renders close to its transcript, so turn 1261 anchors a real 0..88.
The receipts test asserts phantom === 0 and wrong === 0, so it fails if this regresses.

blank row between two turns.
